newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Lyonnais satisfied with breakeven for full year.
newsitem.headline: Cr Lyonnais satisfied with breakeven for full year.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais chairman Jean Peyrelevade said on Thursday that he would be satisfied with a breakeven result for full-year 1996 after the state-controlled bank announced a half-year profit of 67 million francs.
"I would be satisifed if after all the provisions for restructuring...we were at breakeven," he told reporters.
The first half net attributable profit of 67 million francs compared with a profit of 36 million for the corresponding year earlier period.
Peyrelevade expected a 1.3 billion franc charge taken in the first half represented the lion's share of the charges it would have to take for its restructuring programme.
"The provision in the second half will be much less," he said. The bank's restructuring involves the elimination of 5,000 jobs by the end of 1998, reducing its payroll to 30,000 from 35,000.
